text_block_list.name: Narration?
text_block_list.text: "The Strongest Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Narration?
text_block_list.text: Who did you just picture in your mind?

text_block_list.name: Narration?
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume who claimed GⅠ victories through overwhelming strength.
However, being the "strongest" doesn't end there.

text_block_list.name: Narration?
text_block_list.text: This is the beginning of the story of a certain Umamusume who dreamed of becoming the "strongest."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: What is it, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: This footage is to make sure Trainer-san and I are on the exact same page.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Could you take a look first?
We can do the Q&A after that, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Narration?
text_block_list.text:
Royce and Royce—
Her early racing career was smooth sailing.

text_block_list.name: Narration?
text_block_list.text:
"A racing prodigy." "A future GⅠ Umamusume."
Seeing her run, her parents showered her with praise.

text_block_list.name: Narration?
text_block_list.text:
However, through an encounter with a singular prodigy Umamusume—
Tokai Teio—
she would be forced to face reality.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
A genius... It refers to an Umamusume like her, doesn't it?
Compared to Teio-san, someone like me is just...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I might have a decent amount of talent.
But 'decent' just isn't good enough!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I don't wanna just be one of the pack.
If I'm gonna run—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I want to be "the strongest Umamusume"!
I want everyone to call me that!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: I want to become the "strongest Umamusume," one that everyone will want to talk about for generations!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
'The strongest'... It is a magical title.
At first glance, it seems to represent the very pinnacle, but—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Actually, there are all kinds of 'strongest' titles!
'Strongest of their Generation,' 'Strongest Stayer,' 'Strongest Front-Runner'...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Then there must be a way for me to become the "strongest" too!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
And if I can claim the title of the "Strongest"...
I can become eternal!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Even in future generations, many people
will talk about me and sing my praises!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Conversely, if I can't deliver a performance worthy of the 'strongest' title...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Before long, she probably won't be able to stay in the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Skill, or fan support.
If you have neither, there's no way you'll survive.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That's why I thought desperately...
about how to become the "strongest."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: That's self-producing!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
With a record worthy of graded race victories and unforgettable drama,
we can forge the 'strongest'!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...That will be all for now.
Please feel free to ask if you have any questions."
choice_data_list: Maybe I didn't see a bad ending coming...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's good to hear.
Make sure to share your vision with each other.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Alright, next up is the "Self-Producing Chapter"!
Let's move to a different spot!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We visited the Umamusume Museum.
Paintings of legendary Umamusume lined the walls.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Let's look back at racing history
and examine some successful examples
of self-producing.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Even so, since they probably didn't intend to self-produce,
it's a case of natural success.
choice_data_list: But they're all the "strongest Umamusume," right?
But they're all the "strongest Umamusume," aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"That's true, but... ah,
look, like her, for example."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: The "Idol Umamusume", Haiseiko-san!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Rising from the regional circuit to the Central—
that Cinderella story captured everyone's hearts
and sparked a massive racing boom!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I see, so a Cinderella story corresponds to the drama of forging the "strongest".
choice_data_list: Which means, the other idol Umamusume is also—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Oguri Cap is undeniably
one of the 'strongest Umamusume' too!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Other than the idol route...
Oh, Rudolf-san just reminded me!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf-san, the "Emperor,"
is naturally the "strongest" with her exceptional abilities.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: “However, there is an Umamusume famous for a shocking victory who defeated that very Rudolf-san!”

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Rudolf-san is the "strongest" in the record books,
and she is the "strongest" in our memories.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"And then... there are many among runaway front-runners too.
Like the Umamusume whose runaway style was so near a full sprint that people called it sheer madness."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: She did win two of the Classic crowns, but people mostly talk about her runaway front-running style rather than her actual record.
choice_data_list: Now that you mention it, you're right...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apart from Umamusume with extraordinary race records,
the ones who stick in my memory are those
with compelling drama behind them.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Right?
For the 'strongest Umamusume,' drama is essential!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That's why we're going to focus on self-producing
and creating drama!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Now then, next I'd like to explain the specifics
of the self-production plan—
choice_data_list: Ah, wait a second! I've got something to report.
Ah, wait a second! I have something to report.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The screening started so abruptly that I missed my chance to report,
but if we're going to review the plan, I need to tell her now.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: You're making your debut?! Why didn't you tell me sooner?!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean you've got a rough idea ready?!
The timing, the distance, and the racetrack!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Well then, well then, let's gather the latest data on your classmates,
analyze it, check the racetrack fan trends too—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I can't just sit around!
I need to optimize my self-producing strategy in time for my debut!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
And with that, the meeting is adjourned!
I need to rethink my plans, so excuse me!
choice_data_list: No, let me explain about your debut first!?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course!
How am I supposed to optimize without asking that first, silly me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Royce and Royce.
Brilliantly smart, yet sometimes running in circles
from getting too carried away—with her...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Our days of self-producing her path to becoming the 'strongest' had begun!
